listRoleRolegrant 

List all users, groups, and roles a role has been granted to. This includes transitive grants.

For example, if Role B has been granted to Role A, and Role C has been granted to Role B, the grants returned in this API for Role A will include both Role B and Role C.

Similarly, in this example, if User Y and User Z both have been granted Role A, querying this API for Role C will include both users.
Both users can assume Role C via their transitive grants of Role A.

For more information about roles, please visit https://docs.starburst.io/starburst-galaxy/security/roles.html
path Parameters
roleId
required
string
  • A role
  • This parameter can be looked up using name instead of its Id. Use name=value instead of an Id to lookup/search using the value. value must be encoded (see RFC including =)
query Parameters

createContext

Push an as-code document to an existing named connection. The connection then holds exactly this document: anything an earlier push created that the document no longer contains is removed, so pushing a different document to the same connection replaces the previous one.

BETA API: This API is subject to incompatible changes, or even removal, in the future.

resolveContextConflict

Resolves a context conflict by deciding which values to keep. Nothing is applied if the conflict changed since it was listed.

BETA API: This API is subject to incompatible changes, or even removal, in the future.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
contextConflictId
required
string

ID of the conflict, as returned when listing conflicts

expectedMainEntityId
required
string

Id of the main entity, as returned when listing conflicts

syncToken
required
string

Used to ensure consistency for resource updates. A syncToken that is returned from the server is valid until the resource is updated when a new syncToken will be generated. Only the latest version of the object is maintained. (read only)

mode
required
string
Enum: "TakeStaged" "KeepMain" "PerField"

TakeStaged takes every staged value, KeepMain keeps every main value, PerField decides per field using fieldChoices

required
Array of objects (ContextConflictFieldChoice)

Decisions for the conflicting fields, only allowed for PerField. A conflicting field without a decision keeps its main value.
